import numpy as np
import albumentations as A

def color_augmentation_pipeline():
    pipeline = A.Compose([
        A.HueSaturationValue(
            hue_shift_limit=20,
            sat_shift_limit=30,
            val_shift_limit=20,
            p=0.5
        ),
        A.RGBShift(
            r_shift_limit=20,
            g_shift_limit=20,
            b_shift_limit=20,
            p=0.5
        ),
        A.CLAHE(
            clip_limit=2.0,
            tile_grid_size=(8, 8),
            p=0.3
        ),
        A.ChannelShuffle(p=0.2)
    ])
    return pipeline

sample_image = np.random.randint(0, 256, (64, 64, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
pipeline = color_augmentation_pipeline()
augmented = pipeline(image=sample_image)['image']

print(f"Original shape: {sample_image.shape}")
print(f"Augmented shape: {augmented.shape}")
assert augmented.shape == sample_image.shape
